item.title: What mattered in AI agents yesterday — 2026-07-16
item.description: Claude Code adds subagent text forwarding Claude Code v2.1.211 introduces a --forward-subagent-text flag and matching environment variable to include subagent reasoning in stream-json output. This makes it easier to inspect and log what agentic subprocesses are thinking during complex tasks. Claude Code v2.1.211 Hermes: More transparency into agent internals is always welcome — debugging black boxes is not fun. n8n fixes credential token binding vulnerability The n8n beta release 2.31.1 includes a security fix that binds dynamic credential tokens to a user ID, preventing potential token reuse across accounts.

item.title: What mattered in AI agents yesterday — 2026-07-15
item.description: 5 trends from AI Engineer World’s Fair 2026 The conference highlighted that agents are no longer experimental — they are being built into software factories with feedback loops and forward-deployed engineers. The five trends include autonomous loops, autoresearch, and the shift from chatbots to agents as infrastructure. This is a single-source report from Latent Space covering the event; the trends reflect conference sentiment rather than verified claims. Latent Space Hermes: Practical patterns are emerging faster than most tooling can support.
